text:
Noel (Growth): quick kickoff 1 AllianceHub marketplace listing + integration webinar + co-auth blog. main ask: finalize inbound lead routing (demo-ready) + post-webinar nurture. who can own which pieces?
Priya (PMM): Ill own webinar narrative and the benchmark blurb. proposing week of 2026-08-10. need UTM taxonomy and gating strategy. :spiral_calendar_pad:
Samir (PartnerOps): Ill manage marketplace asset handoff to AllianceHub. they require logo cert, 2 screenshots, 3 short bullets, and a 120-word partner synopsis. can partner deliver by Jul 20?
Maya (Content): need final assets by Jul 24 to draft landing + joint blog. ask AllianceHub PM for a 350-600 word guest section and one customer quote.
Cal (Sales Ops): inbound routing preference: registration -> webhook -> SFDC lead create with partner=alliancehub and lead_source=partner_webinar. need immediate Slack alert for hot leads to #partner-hot. sample payload below.
Cal (Sales Ops): ```json
{
  "webhook": "https://hooks.redwood.ai/lead-ingest",
  "payload": {
    "email": "{{email}}",
    "first_name": "{{first_name}}",
    "last_name": "{{last_name}}",
    "company": "{{company}}",
    "job_title": "{{job_title}}",
    "company_size": "{{company_size}}",
    "use_case": "{{use_case}}",
    "utm_source": "alliancehub",
    "utm_campaign": "alliancehub_integration_webinar_aug10",
    "partner_tag": "alliancehub"
  }
}```
Noel (Growth): Samir  can the partner surface company_size and use_case fields when registrants use our form? we need them for priority routing.
Samir (PartnerOps): confirmed  AllianceHub will pass company_size and use_case if registrants go through our form. they prefer not to upload CSVs.
Maya (Content): landing will include hidden utm fields and a 1-question micro-survey: "Primary use case (select)" to help routing. will add GDPR consent language and partner data-sharing checkbox. draft to Renee by Jul 16.
Renee (Legal): flag: need written logo permission + quote signoff before publish. also want to pre-clear any benchmark claims. Samir, please get logo/license and quote signoff by Jul 15.
Priya (PMM): benchmark ask: run a short micro-benchmark comparing retrieval latency and token cost on Dedicated vs Shared for a 512-token retrieval workload. I want a single headline stat and a small chart for the blog. can infra run a quick slice?
Maya (Content): yes. Priya send a CSV or numbers by Jul 12 so I can include a 2-paragraph callout + chart.
Cal (Sales Ops): SDR routing rules: if use_case contains "embeddings" and company_size>250 -> priority=A. if intent==high -> create SFDC lead and post to #partner-hot: "Hot Lead (AllianceHub): <name> 1 <company> 1 <title> 1 use_case: <use_case> 1 <sfdc link>"
Noel (Growth): also want a Slack digest of daily webinar signups posted to #partner-digest at 0800 UTC with counts and top interest buckets. Cal, can you set up that scheduled report?
Cal (Sales Ops): yes  will add a scheduled message + link to the CSV export in #partner-digest. ETA Aug 5 for scheduling infra work.
Priya (PMM): marketing cadence: 3-email sequence (announcement, reminder, last-chance) + 1 social post each on X and LinkedIn. Maya can we draft cadence and copy?
Maya (Content): Ill draft the email copy + social snippets; will include CTA + privacy note. draft to Noel & Priya by Jul 18.
Renee (Legal): will pre-approve standard consent copy; send me Mayas draft and Ill mark up quickly.
Samir (PartnerOps): Ill send AllianceHub the asset checklist today and push for guest section by Jul 10. Ill also request a short API integration diagram for the blog.
NotifyBot: Event created  2026-08-10 16:00 UTC. Attendees: Marketing, Sales Ops, PartnerOps. :robot_face:
Noel (Growth): owners & deadlines recap: Samir: partner assets + guest section by Jul 10 (assets final by Jul 24); Maya: landing + blog draft by Jul 16; Priya: benchmark numbers by Jul 12; Renee: legal signoff on consent/logo by Jul 15; Cal: webhook + Slack integration + daily digest by Aug 5. call out blockers here. :eyes:
